summary: Thin __thiscall forwarder: calls ShortComputation_16e0 (0x004916E0) with the receiver advanced by 18 word elements and four zero arguments, then returns that call's __int16 result unchanged. Acts as a subsystem initialization shim.

operations.description: Call ShortComputation_16e0 (0x004916E0) with the __thiscall receiver this advanced by 18 word elements and four zero arguments.
Return the __int16 result of ShortComputation_16e0 unchanged.

unresolved: The receiver this + 18 (word elements) points into the owning object; the exact field and its purpose are unknown.
Semantics of ShortComputation_16e0 are unknown; this thunk only forwards the four zero arguments without transformation.
Owner class is unknown; the legacy ABI name is Subsystem_Init_Thunk.
